records.title: Development of Airports in Andhra Pradesh.
details: a to b: GoAP has submitted proposals seeking Site Clearance for proposed airports at Kuppam and Srikakulam, as per Greenfield Airports (GFA) Policy. These proposals are under consideration.

records.title: Withdrawal of Embarkation Facility At Gannav Aram Airport
details: b): The subject matter is under active consideration of the Competent Authority, based on inputs from relevant stakeholders in this matter.

records.title: Status of one District one Product
details: b: Under the initiative, District Export Action Plans detailing the existing bottlenecks in the supply chain and identifying possible interventions to mitigate the existing gaps have been prepared for 590 districts and are being prepared for the rest of the district

records.title: DISPLACEMENTS DUE TO INTER-LINKING OF RIVERS.
details: b to d: Monitoring Committee for R&R has been constituted under the Chairmanship of the Secretary, Department of Land Resources, Ministry of Rural Development of India, to oversee the effective implementation and monitoring of land acquisition and the R&R Plan for the project.

records.title: SVAMITVA Scheme
details: Part (a), (b) & (d): In Andhra Pradesh, drone survey has been completed in 13,280 villages (District-wise details at Annexure-II) and 2,56,669 property cards have been distributed in 692 villages. However, property cards are yet to be prepared in the new format.

records.title: Pre-Feasibility Test on PCPIR in Andhra Pradesh
details: Part (a) to (e) : In July, 2021, Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas constituted a Joint Working Group comprising representatives from M/o P&NG, Government of Andhra Pradesh, GAIL, HPCL and EIL, to revisit the project. A study has concluded that Viability Gap Funding would be required to make the project viable.
